text: Hana and Anders got engaged on Saturday night! He proposed on the beach in Whitby. The wedding will probably be next summer.

Nina's cat Biscuit is having a lump removed on Thursday morning. She's really worried about the anaesthetic. I should text her that afternoon to see how it went. She also said her brother Anders is finally moving out of her spare room next month, so she's turning it into a proper office. Sounds like she's earned it.
Gareth has a flat viewing in Leeds on Friday at 3pm. If it goes well he and his girlfriend could move by the end of the month.
Viewing at Clarendon Road tomorrow at 10am. Bring the list of questions about the boiler and the deposit.
Hiroshi mentioned his parents' 40th anniversary is on the 14th. They're doing a quiet dinner at home, but he'd love to find them something special.
Jess picked up her new puppy yesterday, a cocker spaniel called Pip. She's absolutely smitten and hasn't slept.
Don't forget to send Demi a card for her wedding anniversary next Tuesday. Five years, I think.
Louis is moving to Glasgow in a fortnight for the new job. His last day at the office is Friday, and there are leaving drinks at the Crown from 6.
Emre's dog Kofi turned three today. Apparently there was a cake made of liver and peanut butter.

Yasmin is struggling a bit with the move. The new flat in Bristol still has no internet, and her landlord isn't answering. Need to ring her this weekend and check she's okay. Her girlfriend Kiri is still in Cardiff until December, so she's doing most of it on her own, and the cat hates the new place. Maybe offer to drive down one Saturday.
Ayesha and Ibrahim are getting married on the 12th of June in Lahore. Invitations are going out next month. I must book flights before prices go up.
Björn's wedding has been called off. He and Kate split up last week. He seemed calm on the phone but I'm not sure he is.
Aidan wants a bird feeder camera for his birthday. He's obsessed with the robins in his garden.
Natasha has her second viewing on Wednesday at half 5. She's nervous because the agent says there are three other offers.
Arjun's mum is moving into sheltered housing on Monday. He's taking the day off to help her. Remind me to ask him how she's settling in by the end of the week.
Helen said the vet thinks her old cat Smudge might have kidney trouble. Bloods are back on Friday morning.
Ryan proposed to Kiri at the top of Snowdon this morning! She said yes. Must send them both a congratulations message tonight.
Picked up the keys to the new place today. Movers booked for Saturday at 8am. Still need to cancel the broadband at the old flat.
Abigail is vegan and doesn't drink. Worth remembering for the housewarming.

Rosa and Malik's anniversary is this Sunday. They're going to the Lake District for the weekend and leaving their dog Bramble with Rosa's sister Laura. Malik told me he's had a ring engraved for her, but she thinks they're just getting a takeaway on Sunday night. It'll be eight years, and they met at my thirtieth, which still makes me laugh.
Dawit got the flat in Manchester! He signs the lease on Thursday and moves in on the 1st. He's already planning a housewarming.
Antoine Dubois called. His parrot Coco is 25 this year, which is older than his daughter. He's throwing it a small party, honestly.
Aisha is having a really rough week. Her rabbit died on Sunday and then her landlord gave notice on Tuesday. I should take her for coffee tomorrow afternoon.
Ivan's sister is getting married in Kraków in September. He's the best man and terrified about the speech.
Sofia and her partner viewed a two-bed in Clapton on Saturday and loved it. They're putting in an offer tomorrow morning.
Marisol mentioned she'd love a decent label maker for the new flat. Good gift idea for her birthday in November.
Hana's puppy has started puppy classes on Tuesday evenings. She says he's the worst in the class but the most enthusiastic.
Gareth's engagement party is at his parents' place on Saturday the 7th at 7pm. I'm bringing the prosecco.
Need to ask Jess how the vet appointment went yesterday. Pip had his first jabs.
Anders works for the council in planning. He said he'd look over our extension drawings if we buy the house on Elm Street.
Nina is thinking of moving to Lisbon next spring. She's been learning Portuguese for a year and works remotely anyway.

Phone call with Emre Kowalski this morning. His wife Yasmin is expecting their second in March, and they need a bigger place, so they've started looking at houses in Didsbury. He's also stressed because his boss wants him back in the office three days a week from next Monday. Remind me to send him the details of the mortgage broker we used.
Demi's dog Ralph had surgery on his knee on Friday. Recovery is six weeks of crate rest, which she says is harder on her than him.
Louis and his fiancé Antoine are doing a small registry office wedding on the 19th at 11am, then lunch for twenty. I'm one of the witnesses.
Bins go out Thursday night. Gas meter reading before the end of the month.
Kate's moving back in with her parents for a few months while she saves for a deposit. She doesn't seem too bothered about it.
Arjun Kim, or AK as everyone at work calls him, is relocating to the Singapore office in January. His wife Helen and the kids follow at Easter.
Abigail's grandparents celebrate their diamond anniversary next Saturday. The whole family is going to Cornwall for it. Ask her for photos after.
Ryan's cat Pickle went missing on Monday night. Still no sign of her this morning. He's put posters up around Hackney.
Don't forget: the estate agent is coming at 2pm on Friday to value the flat.
Kiri's brother Malik is getting married in Auckland at Christmas. She's flying out on the 18th and staying three weeks. Need to remember to water her plants while she's away.

Rosa told me her dad's retiring at the end of the year after thirty years at the hospital. She wants to organise a surprise party for him in early January. She asked if we could host it here since her flat is tiny. I said yes in principle. Need to check with Gareth before confirming, and find out how many people she's thinking of inviting.
Malik hates surprises, apparently. Make sure nobody tells him about Rosa's plans.
The housewarming at Dawit's on Saturday has been cancelled because the flat flooded. He's staying with his cousin until the insurance sorts it out. Should check on him tomorrow evening.
Laura Morris is the friend of Helen's who breeds cockapoos. She's got a litter due in about two weeks if we decide to go for it.
Ibrahim has his driving theory test on Tuesday at 9:15. He's failed it twice and is quietly dreading it. Text him good luck Monday night.
Ivan's partner Sofia surprised him with a weekend in Rome for their tenth anniversary. They fly out Friday after work and come back Monday morning.

Coffee with Marisol and Aisha this afternoon. Marisol has just started as a vet nurse at the practice on Mill Lane and loves it. Aisha is still weighing up whether to leave London for York. Her partner Hiroshi got a job offer there, starting in February, and they've got a viewing booked for a terraced house next Saturday. She's excited but worried about leaving her mum.
Yasmin's hamster is called Professor. Not relevant, just funny.
Booked the removal van for the 28th. Pack the kitchen the weekend before.
Jess and Aidan's wedding was beautiful. Must send them the photos from the ceilidh this week.
Björn's new place in Stockholm has a sauna in the basement. He's going to invite us over in spring.

Hiroshi's dog Mochi is getting old and has stopped eating properly. He's taking her to the vet on Monday at 4. He sounded upset. She's fourteen now, and he got her the week he moved to London, so she's been with him through everything. I should give him a ring on Monday evening once he's back from the vet.
Kate and Natasha have been together seven years today. They said they're not big on anniversaries, but Natasha secretly booked a table at the Thai place.

Helen's daughter Abigail graduates on Wednesday morning. Helen is so proud she nearly cried telling me. Abigail's moving to Dundee in September to start a master's in marine biology, and Helen is already dreading the empty house. Maybe send Abigail a card with a little something for the new flat.
Gareth is allergic to cats, which rules out half of the flats he's seen.
I'm driving to Edinburgh on Friday to look at flats. Back Sunday night. Two viewings on Saturday, one at 11 and one at half 2.
Follow up with Nina about the Lisbon flat she viewed over video on Monday. She was waiting to hear back from the landlord.
Dr Novak, Demi's mother-in-law, is the one who knows about the good kennels near Hebden Bridge. Ask Demi for her number before we go away on the 3rd.

Long chat with Laura last night. Her nan's ninetieth is next Sunday and she's baking the cake. Her puppy Toffee chewed through the charger cable on Tuesday. And she and Ryan have finally set a date: the 22nd of August next year, at the barn near Ludlow. She wants me to help with the hen do, so I need to send her some ideas by Friday evening.
